item.text:
I found no telemetry implementation. The likely change points are [config/config.go](/app/config/config.go:118) for default enabled settings, environment loading, and the state directory; [cmd/flipt/main.go](/app/cmd/flipt/main.go:215) for starting a cancellable reporter without making telemetry errors stop the server; and a new `telemetry/telemetry.go` for state persistence and four hour reports. [advanced.yml](/app/config/testdata/advanced.yml:39) needs the explicit opt out.

The requested `internal/info/flipt.go` does not exist. The current info handler and build version live in [cmd/flipt/main.go](/app/cmd/flipt/main.go:582), so the version must be shared with or passed to the reporter. The reporting destination and client are unspecified; that limits a precise transport diagnosis.

The fix should cover stable UUID recovery, RFC3339 timestamps updated only after a successful `flipt.ping`, directory and file path cases, and an opt out that performs no state or network work. Existing config tests pass (`GOPROXY=off go test ./config`); they do not cover telemetry. I recorded the findings in `.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md`. Under this run’s fault-localization constraint, I did not edit project source or tests.
